title: The all-temperature spherical Gaussian perceptron pressure
exact_target: For the uniform sphere of radius sqrt(N), iid standard Gaussian constraint rows $M=floor(\alpha $ N), every $\alpha ,\beta >0$ and bounded continuous real activation phi, does the normalized log partition function converge in mean and probability to $inf_m$ \{alpha $V_(\beta $ phi)(m)+S(m)\} over the stated monotone trial functions, allowing all finite-entropy trials without requiring $m=1$ near the endpoint?
